body: Alliance AI Partners is an AI company based in the Philippines. It works as part of its partners’ teams in the United States, Australia and the United Kingdom, helping them scale AI, solve business problems with AI and grow. Its team automates slow work, builds AI software and support tools, and adds developers when partners need more hands, then stays to keep everything running and help partners win more customers.
One line: Alliance AI Partners helps companies put AI to work so they can grow faster.
Sample address until our domain is chosen. We reply within [one working day].

sections.note: The logo kit's size is the real file (brand-kit/downloads/alliance-ai-partners-logo-kit.zip, 942,389 bytes, 90 files: 57 SVG, 30 PNG, an ICO, the webmanifest and a README). The brand guide PDF does not exist yet, so its size stays [size]; press photos are 'To come'. The brand guide and press photos rows have no Download action (hidden in the instance) until the files exist; the brand guide reads 'PDF · [size] · To come'. The row's action is the SM Quiet button (36 px): on touch screens make the whole row the link, or give the action a 44 px target, since the component has no Mobile variant.

content.heading: Give it room.

notes: Header marks About as current. The page's one Primary is the logo kit download in the hero (desktop y 478, mobile 354); Copy the boilerplate is Secondary. Images: all existing rasters, presented three ways: the brand board as a framed product visual in the hero split (IMG-32-1), and a mosaic of merch mockups of different sizes (IMG-32-2 tote, IMG-32-3 notebook, IMG-32-4 mug; mobile drops the mug). Logos, marks and colour swatches are real components and bound variables, not images. Specimen tiles are white with a hairline or Partner Navy; they show artwork, not section grounds. The Colours section is a navy chapter so the Ribbon Cyan swatch never sits on a light ground; the Daybreak bar's gradient stops are bound to the Partner Navy, Alliance Blue and Ribbon Cyan variables. Facts: clear space, minimum sizes, colour values (hex, RGB, CMYK) and the Print Black rule come from docs/brand-kit/README.md and palette.json; type sizes from DESIGN.md; the licence from design-system/README.md; the logo kit size from the real file (942,389 bytes). The boilerplate is built from the Brand DNA's 'Who we are' and elevator pitch, and the one-line version is its one-sentence pitch. Placeholders kept: [size] for the brand guide PDF (not made yet), 'To come' for press photos, [one working day] for the press reply time (owner check), and the sample address press@allianceaipartners.example. The four Don't tiles show a rotated logo, a recoloured (grey) logo, the light logo on navy and the name typed in Mona Sans; none adds a shadow or glow. Lint clean on both frames (three long-measure texts narrowed on desktop); no overflow on mobile. Reviewed 2026-11-03: every logo specimen was below the brand kit's minimum sizes (the 72 px instance holds a 45.7 px mark and 191 px of artwork) and the clear-space box sat 21 px outside an artboard that already carries x, showing about 2.6 x; both fixed as described per section.
